messages.subject: Stage 3 committed: hermes/config.template.yaml only
messages.body: Confirmed git status showed only hermes/config.template.yaml modified and .orca/ untracked, staged that single file, and committed as 6a51bfc ('fix(deploy): pin Hermes auxiliary lane to free OpenRouter models') with a body explaining the paid-fallback risk and the version-pinned verification. git show --stat confirms exactly one file changed (10 insertions), and git status --short now shows only .orca/ untracked with a clean working tree otherwise. Nothing was pushed: HEAD (6a51bfc) is one commit ahead of origin/main (8a7166d), origin/main is unchanged, and no secret was printed at any point.
